units.id: news:avgi siege civilian|"Dejection. Once this star system was our own, but now we only hold the soil beneath our wings."|32|0
units.english: "Dejection. Once this star system was our own, but now we only hold the soil beneath our wings."
units.raw: `"Dejection. Once this star system was our own, but now we only hold the soil beneath our wings."`

units.id: news:avgi siege civilian|"Rejection. The Consonance claims to speak for the Avgi, yet none of us in the occupied systems voted for their rule."|33|0
units.english: "Rejection. The Consonance claims to speak for the Avgi, yet none of us in the occupied systems voted for their rule."
units.raw: `"Rejection. The Consonance claims to speak for the Avgi, yet none of us in the occupied systems voted for their rule."`

units.id: news:avgi siege civilian|"Remembrance. The Aberrations tried to bombard our cities early in the war, but our defense systems were able to shoot most of their projectiles down."|34|0
units.english: "Remembrance. The Aberrations tried to bombard our cities early in the war, but our defense systems were able to shoot most of their projectiles down."
units.raw: `"Remembrance. The Aberrations tried to bombard our cities early in the war, but our defense systems were able to shoot most of their projectiles down."`

units.id: news:avgi siege civilian|"Remembrance. Much of my family was lost when the Aberrant destroyed our cylinder habitats. In the Anax system, only the Nisos Cylinder survived."|35|0
units.english: "Remembrance. Much of my family was lost when the Aberrant destroyed our cylinder habitats. In the Anax system, only the Nisos Cylinder survived."
units.raw: `"Remembrance. Much of my family was lost when the Aberrant destroyed our cylinder habitats. In the Anax system, only the Nisos Cylinder survived."`

units.id: news:avgi siege civilian|"Guilt. Twelve million Avgi lived on each of the cylinder habitats. Less than one in six made it out alive."|36|0
units.english: "Guilt. Twelve million Avgi lived on each of the cylinder habitats. Less than one in six made it out alive."
units.raw: `"Guilt. Twelve million Avgi lived on each of the cylinder habitats. Less than one in six made it out alive."`

units.id: news:avgi siege civilian|"Worry. If not for our ground-to-orbit laser batteries, the Aberrant would surely have invaded the surface by now."|37|0
units.english: "Worry. If not for our ground-to-orbit laser batteries, the Aberrant would surely have invaded the surface by now."
units.raw: `"Worry. If not for our ground-to-orbit laser batteries, the Aberrant would surely have invaded the surface by now."`

units.id: news:avgi siege civilian|"Sorrow. You can see the debris from our shattered skyhooks in orbit with the naked eye."|38|0
units.english: "Sorrow. You can see the debris from our shattered skyhooks in orbit with the naked eye."
units.raw: `"Sorrow. You can see the debris from our shattered skyhooks in orbit with the naked eye."`

units.id: news:avgi siege civilian|"Anger. Why did the Consonance have to abandon our space? The surface of our core planets could have sheltered our ships, but instead they ran to save themselves."|39|0
units.english: "Anger. Why did the Consonance have to abandon our space? The surface of our core planets could have sheltered our ships, but instead they ran to save themselves."
units.raw: `"Anger. Why did the Consonance have to abandon our space? The surface of our core planets could have sheltered our ships, but instead they ran to save themselves."`

units.id: news:avgi siege civilian|"Curiosity. I've never been to the Tangled Shroud, but I heard it is a safe place away from the Aberrant."|40|0
units.english: "Curiosity. I've never been to the Tangled Shroud, but I heard it is a safe place away from the Aberrant."
units.raw: `"Curiosity. I've never been to the Tangled Shroud, but I heard it is a safe place away from the Aberrant."`

units.id: news:avgi siege civilian|"Satisfaction. Every time an Aberration comes too close, we hit it with half a dozen surface-to-orbit nuclear missiles."|41|0
units.english: "Satisfaction. Every time an Aberration comes too close, we hit it with half a dozen surface-to-orbit nuclear missiles."
units.raw: `"Satisfaction. Every time an Aberration comes too close, we hit it with half a dozen surface-to-orbit nuclear missiles."`

units.id: news:avgi siege civilian|"Optimism. Despite the siege of our star systems, the surface of our inhabited planets remain quite safe from attack."|42|0
units.english: "Optimism. Despite the siege of our star systems, the surface of our inhabited planets remain quite safe from attack."
units.raw: `"Optimism. Despite the siege of our star systems, the surface of our inhabited planets remain quite safe from attack."`

units.id: news:avgi siege merchant|"Relief. You wouldn't believe how hard it is to run a blockade against those Aberrant!"|62|0
units.english: "Relief. You wouldn't believe how hard it is to run a blockade against those Aberrant!"
units.raw: `"Relief. You wouldn't believe how hard it is to run a blockade against those Aberrant!"`

units.id: news:avgi siege merchant|"Frustration. We'd be able to smuggle more people out to the Tangled Shroud in the south if there was room to house them all."|63|0
units.english: "Frustration. We'd be able to smuggle more people out to the Tangled Shroud in the south if there was room to house them all."
units.raw: `"Frustration. We'd be able to smuggle more people out to the Tangled Shroud in the south if there was room to house them all."`

units.id: news:avgi siege merchant|"Appeasing. We can't take all of you with us, only these names on the list the Assembly gave us."|64|0
units.english: "Appeasing. We can't take all of you with us, only these names on the list the Assembly gave us."
units.raw: `"Appeasing. We can't take all of you with us, only these names on the list the Assembly gave us."`

units.id: news:avgi siege merchant|"Exasperation. No one understands that we can't just take everyone with us; there simply aren't enough habitats past the Shroud. The Consonance had to set an evacuation quota for a reason!"|65|0
units.english: "Exasperation. No one understands that we can't just take everyone with us; there simply aren't enough habitats past the Shroud. The Consonance had to set an evacuation quota for a reason!"
units.raw: `"Exasperation. No one understands that we can't just take everyone with us; there simply aren't enough habitats past the Shroud. The Consonance had to set an evacuation quota for a reason!"`

units.id: news:avgi siege merchant|"Frustration. We're always being asked to try and retrieve advanced equipment from the homeworlds, but it's simply too difficult to get it back to the Shroud."|66|0
units.english: "Frustration. We're always being asked to try and retrieve advanced equipment from the homeworlds, but it's simply too difficult to get it back to the Shroud."
units.raw: `"Frustration. We're always being asked to try and retrieve advanced equipment from the homeworlds, but it's simply too difficult to get it back to the Shroud."`

units.id: news:avgi siege hatchling|"Wonder. I heard we could once travel the stars. Do you think we'll ever return?"|86|0
units.english: "Wonder. I heard we could once travel the stars. Do you think we'll ever return?"
units.raw: `"Wonder. I heard we could once travel the stars. Do you think we'll ever return?"`

units.id: news:avgi siege hatchling|"Confusion. How is it that there are Avgi in other star systems, but we can't launch anything from this planet without it being destroyed?"|87|0
units.english: "Confusion. How is it that there are Avgi in other star systems, but we can't launch anything from this planet without it being destroyed?"
units.raw: `"Confusion. How is it that there are Avgi in other star systems, but we can't launch anything from this planet without it being destroyed?"`

units.id: news:avgi siege hatchling|"Sadness. I don't know if I'll ever be able to visit another planet."|88|0
units.english: "Sadness. I don't know if I'll ever be able to visit another planet."
units.raw: `"Sadness. I don't know if I'll ever be able to visit another planet."`

units.id: news:avgi siege hatchling|"Hurt. Why do the aliens attack us? We never did anything to them."|89|0
units.english: "Hurt. Why do the aliens attack us? We never did anything to them."
units.raw: `"Hurt. Why do the aliens attack us? We never did anything to them."`

units.id: news:avgi siege hatchling|"Loss. I was born on a space station, but now I am trapped on a planet, weighed down by the ground itself."|90|0
units.english: "Loss. I was born on a space station, but now I am trapped on a planet, weighed down by the ground itself."
units.raw: `"Loss. I was born on a space station, but now I am trapped on a planet, weighed down by the ground itself."`

units.id: news:avgi siege hatchling|"Despair. My family was lost in an Aberrant attack a year ago. It will never be the same again."|91|0
units.english: "Despair. My family was lost in an Aberrant attack a year ago. It will never be the same again."
units.raw: `"Despair. My family was lost in an Aberrant attack a year ago. It will never be the same again."`
